subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reler e revisar o texto produzido com a ajuda do professor e a colaboração dos colegas, para corrigi-lo e aprimorá-lo, fazendo cortes, acréscimos, reformulações, correções de ortografia e pontuação.

components.description_pt: Reler um texto produzido para identificar passagens que precisam revisão ou correção
components.description_en: Reread a produced text to identify passages needing revision or correction
components.cc_component_description: Reread a sentence or passage to clarify word recognition errors

components.description_pt: Revisar um rascunho para melhorar clareza, organização ou desenvolvimento de ideias
components.description_en: Revise a draft to improve clarity, organization, or development of ideas
components.cc_component_description: Revise a draft to improve clarity, organization, or development of ideas

components.description_pt: Revisar escrita para identificar e corrigir erros de capitalização, pontuação e ortografia
components.description_en: Proofread writing to identify and correct errors in capitalization, punctuation, and spelling
components.cc_component_description: Proofread writing to identify and correct errors in capitalization, punctuation, and spelling

components.description_pt: Revisar um texto colaborativamente com colegas e com orientação do professor
components.description_en: Revise a text collaboratively with peers and with teacher guidance
components.cc_component_description: Collaborate with peers using technology to develop or revise shared writing

cc_matches.description: Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and to interact and collaborate with others.
Use context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.
